town_description: Belagavi (formerly Belgaum) is one of Karnataka's oldest cities, in the northwest of the state near the Maharashtra and Goa borders. Its landmarks include the Belgaum Fort with the 1204 Kamala Basti Jain temple, the ancient Kapileshwara Shiva temple known as 'Dakshina Kashi', and the cantonment built by the British. It is also remembered as the region of Kittur Rani Chennamma, one of India's earliest freedom fighters, and is famous for its foundries and the Kunda sweet.
